description: This file defines the WsClient class, a WebSocket client implementation for monitoring purposes in the Thingsboard project. It manages WebSocket connections, message handling, subscriptions for telemetry data, and synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: WsClient
classes.description: A WebSocket client for monitoring, capable of subscribing to telemetry data, handling messages, and managing connection state.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Callback invoked when WebSocket connection is opened.

methods.name: onMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, parsing JSON and updating internal state.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Callback invoked when WebSocket connection is closed.

methods.name: registerWaitForUpdates
methods.description: Prepares to wait for a specified number of update messages.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over WebSocket, initializing reply latch.

methods.name: subscribeForTelemetry
methods.description: Subscribes to telemetry data for specified devices and keys.

methods.name: waitForUpdates
methods.description: Waits for updates within a given timeout.

methods.name: waitForReply
methods.description: Waits for a reply message within the request timeout.

methods.name: getLastMsgs
methods.description: Retrieves the last received messages, checking for errors.

methods.name: getLatest
methods.description: Extracts latest data for a specific device from received messages.

methods.name: onSetSSLParameters
methods.description: Customizes SSL parameters for the connection.
